scenes.title: Sela at pier four
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat and meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them but never at night. Oren's persuasion brings the price to two silver. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang, forty years ago, and the water came up warm. She'll be at pier four at first light.

scenes.title: The Saltmere Mine
scenes.summary: The party walks up the cliff path to the flooded mine. Warm black water and hymn-book pages float inside. One page has "M. Brand" pencilled in the margin, and Teo recognises his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana's search turns up nothing else. Oren takes 2 damage from bad air and drops to 11.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: At dusk the party goes to the shore despite Sela's warning. Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother. At midnight the bell rings twelve times underwater and the humming is much louder than before. Pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor, then vanish, and the party flees.

scenes.title: Stew at the Tarred Gull
scenes.summary: In the tavern the party plans to take Sela's boat at first light and dive to the chapel at low tide. Innkeeper Bram gives them free stew and speaks well of harbor-master Maren, who lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest and is back to full.
